title: Activision Believes GTA 6 Will Help Modern Warfare 4
description: Activision believes GTA 6 will benefit Call of Duty rather than hinder it, expecting Modern Warfare 4 and Rockstar's behemoth to dominate 2026.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Activision's Unexpected Take on GTA 6 and Call of Duty

When a monumental blockbuster is scheduled for release, most publishers typically scramble to adjust their launch windows to avoid getting completely overshadowed. However, Activision has shared a surprisingly optimistic perspective regarding Rockstar Games' upcoming titan. According to recent reports from IGN, Activision believes that GTA 6 will actually benefit the Call of Duty franchise rather than hinder its success.

## Dominating 2026 Together

As the industry looks ahead through 2026, the competitive landscape is shaping up to be historic. Highlighting the massive scale of both franchises, Activision expressed strong confidence in how the market will unfold. In a statement addressing the industry dynamic, it was noted: 'No offense to Zelda, but [GTA and COD] are the 2 biggest games of the year.' This bold outlook underscores the publisher's belief that Modern Warfare 4 and Rockstar's behemoth will stand tall as the two biggest entertainment events of 2026.

## Market Context and Potential Impact

Looking at historical gaming trends, the launch of a once-in-a-generation title like GTA 6 often revitalizes the entire gaming ecosystem, driving hardware sales and bringing lapsed players back to platforms. Industry analysis suggests that this massive influx of engaged gamers can create a rising-tide effect, ultimately benefiting perennial blockbusters like Call of Duty as overall market engagement reaches unprecedented heights.

## Editor's Take

It is rare and refreshing for a major publisher to openly embrace the launch of a direct competitor window. By positioning Modern Warfare 4 alongside GTA 6 as the premier experiences of the year, Activision is betting on a symbiotic market boom. If both games deliver on their massive expectations, 2026 could easily go down as one of the greatest years in gaming history.
